ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) substrate with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution as localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distributed high-contrast white micro-blobs across both lobes; highest density of white pixels occurs along the lower central region and trailing margins; no contiguous large-scale white banding.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 84 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged profile; left lobe features deep, low-frequency macro-notches (step-like); right lobe features higher-frequency micro-serrations with localized peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex lobe curvature, significantly interrupted by deep traumatic notches on the left lobe trailing edge.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density detection of roughly circular white pixel clusters (0.5-2.0% surface area each) across the lower and central fluke, characteristic of barnacle attachment scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint diagonal linear disruptions visible on the right lobe interior and upper left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major tissue loss and irregular macro-serrations on the left lobe trailing edge resulting in a jagged, 'staircase' silhouette; extensive healed surface scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, deep vertical notch located approximately one-quarter of the way in from the left fluke tip.
